# META-INSIGHTS — about the optimization PROCESS itself (this run)

Not about the capability — about HOW this run is searching for it: which strategies/edit classes/algorithms are helping vs stalling, and what to try next iteration. Update at the end of the run at minimum; sooner if a plateau or a clear strategy shift is worth recording now. Structure each addition as:

    ## Iteration <id> (or 'run so far')
    - Strategy tried, and whether it moved val (cite LEDGER rows):
    - Plateau/stall signal, if any, and the lever switched to:
    - What to try next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001
- Strategy tried: for the empty seed, build from an earlier run's accepted capability, compressed for the frontier reader, plus targeted rules for that capability's known regressions on the current val ids. That run's FINAL test rollouts give full traces for every current val task, which makes them a cheap source of counterfactuals ("what would the known-good prompt do here").
- Plateau/stall signal: n/a. Measurement is noisy (single trial; about 24 of 40 val tasks flip between candidates), so judge by cluster-level moves, not single tasks.
- What to try next iteration:
  - Diagnose from cand_0001's own val traces.
  - If a seed-passing task regressed, check whether a §2 rule over-applied and gate it more narrowly; don't delete it wholesale.

## Iteration cand_0002
- Strategy tried: diagnose from the parent's own val traces plus a per-task diff of init vs golden in answer_position. I also ran a scripted stats pass over all 40 tasks: counts of prefilled, changed and formula cells.
  - The stats pass made the "existing formula cells" class visible in minutes (8 tasks have formula targets; 3 of them fail for that reason).
  - It also gave a safety check for the protected tasks: for each proposed rule, script the counterfactual over the 24 passing goldens before shipping it.
- Plateau/stall signal: none.
  - Lever switch: rules that existed but were skipped (exact text, keep prefilled) were moved from prose into verify-phase CHECKS, i.e. STRUCTURE instead of repetition.
- What to try next iteration:
  - Read whether the agent actually printed and acted on the new checks.
  - If a check is ignored, move it into the Phase 2 code sample (code the agent copies) rather than adding words.
